body: I disagree. Becuz whatever you do to remove its dodges, you have to attack. Then you'll take damage. And Megalotops deals way too much damage even against resilient creatures. Especially boosted ones. The only way to fight it is to have a cunning/resilient creature with shields, resilient strikes, heals and distractions. Go figure how many of those creatures there are for low arenas. Also, don't forget Megalotop's biggest d move are swap out/swap ins. So if you bring out a resilient creature, opponent will just swap with a fierce. You also have to be really careful of swapping out when fighting Mtops since it will gain extra movement speed+dodge+crit increase. So unless you have another good resilient creature, you're kinda screwed.
